description: LibreNMS-style device page for factum2-prometheus targets. Status, uptime, site and hardware come from the scrape; traffic, packets, errors and the port table come from if_mib. Ports down counts admin-up interfaces that are operationally down.

panels.title: sysDescr
panels.description: From the snmp_exporter system module. Empty until a scrape succeeds.

targets.expr: count((ifOperStatus{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"} == 2) and on(ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"} == 1)) or vector(0)

topk(8,
  clamp_max(
    (
      rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8
      /
      ((ifHighSpeed{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"} > 0) * 1e6)
    ) * 100
  , 100)
)
sum(rate(ifHCInBroadcastPkts{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(ifInBroadcastPkts{job="snmp", device="$device", ifName=~"$iface"}[$__rate_interval]))
